name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-social
description: Quartz 5 component: sidebar cards for a GitHub user's year of contributions and a Bluesky account's latest posts, fetched in the reader's browser. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits: Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts, and a TypeScript site imports the types from them. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: the component's vnodes must be the host's Preact's, and lightningcss is the parser Quartz reads CSS with, so a colour option passes exactly when Quartz would read it as one. The types are imported for types only.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/, which inlines the family's colour-value check from tags-core, and the cards' browser script, which inlines the widgets library's Bluesky client and renderer; @chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check checks the stylesheet against ADR-0003 before it ships (build.mjs). The libraries are `workspace:*` specs, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published versions (ADR-0005). @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes the .d.ts beside each entry (build.mjs).

quartz.name: cgc-social
quartz.description: Sidebar cards for a GitHub user's year of contributions and a Bluesky account's latest posts, fetched in the reader's browser.
